notes.title: 1.0.2 Update!! Online Match improvement and you can finally crouch now! LOL
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39192291/0a1cfa5ab4f629fc7fafeba88342465c425fff81.png[/img]

Hello Animal Fighters!

Firstly, once again thank you all for supporting Fight of Animals: Arena.
This update will hopefully optimized the online matching issue we had on previous version, please update and try it out!

Update list below:
---
Fixed online sync problem and increase the stability.
Fixed can't cast move problem after air recovery.
Added player's name when selecting stage in online mode.
Change festival style items back into normal.
All characters added crouch attack.
Remove invincible from air dash.
Increase frame of air dash.
Adjusted the animation of air dash.
Adjusted street stage02 some platform, avoid item dropping into spring.
Fixed some bugs.
---

Likewise, if you have any suggestions or feedback. 
Feel free to let us know via our social media!

Cheers! Baaaaaai!

Twitter:
@FightofAnimals

Discord:
https://discord.gg/rPcHb6C

notes.title: Festival Update & Special Promotion! Free Costume update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39192291/3d9bf4b614aca15cc6cec93e2ede8d4b5b39d3af.png[/img]

Hello Guys!!!
Christmas is nearby! We have some updates and surprises for you!
Check it out!

1. All the DLC costumes from Fight of Animals will be free update to Fight of Animals: Arena.

2. Festival theme Items will appear in the game!

[b]3. Special Lucky Draw! 
1. If you purchased Fight of Animals: Arena, give us a review on steam 
2. Get a screenshot of your review, send over it via Twitter to us and you will have a chance to win an extra copy so you can play with your friend!![/b]
*Limited 100 copies only*
https://twitter.com/FightofAnimals

Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!!
Digital Crafter team

*other update log below*

Change some items into Festival style.
All characters added special skin.
All characters added air dash cancel.
All characters JA added jump cancel. (If possible)
All characters basic combo (A > A > A) don't need hit confirm, and increase the stability.
All characters basic combo third attack cause knockdown.
All characters 5S decrease push force. 
Magic Squirrel 6S remove air force.
Dojo added plain stage.
Fixed some bugs.
